fields.description: Length of each repeating window, in days (e.g. 30 = monthly). Drives the Nurse follow-up schedule only - applies to every patient, regardless of High Risk status.
fields.label: Interval Day Count

fields.description: How many windows are automatically calculated before switching to manual entry.
fields.label: Automatic Window Count

fields.description: How many days into each window the Nurse should be nudged to visit early - shown only for patients currently flagged High Risk on Pregnancy Registration. Also used for the urgent follow-up chain's timing after a Risk-completed Nurse visit.
fields.label: Risk Alert Days

fields.description: How many completed Nurse visits close out one window before moving to the next.
fields.label: Visits Required Per Window
